title: manual gdgraph build never records provenance: the command delegates to the copied template runner, which has no recordProvenance

AC1.note: context.md T5 reproduction: a worktree at the pre-fix commit shows gdgraph build writing artifacts and no .provenance.json in a scaffolded project, while sync --apply creates it

AC2.note: gdgraph.test.ts flow-281 block: a delegated build records provenance naming HEAD; a second build with no commits in between keeps the same commit

AC3.note: gdgraph.test.ts regression: with no copied runner the in-process path records provenance unchanged

AC4.note: gdgraph.test.ts: a repository with no commits writes no provenance file; on a detached HEAD the recorded commit is the checked-out one and git cat-file -e confirms it exists

AC5.note: journal.md records the decision (fix in gdgraphCommand after delegation, so existing projects are fixed on the next keryx upgrade without keryx update); templates.ts and gdgraph.ts carry comments for the rejected candidates

AC6.note: PR 638 CI green (18 checks, including typecheck-and-tests over the full suite); keryx health run: PASS
